title: Reefer Cargo Services: Excursion Credit Request Window and Limits
content:
An excursion credit under Reefer Cargo Services is subject to three limits of time and number, independent of how the credit is sized: the period after delivery within which it has to be asked for, the number of credits a single service can receive, and the stage of the service at which a credit can be entered.

## Clause

A request for an excursion credit has to be made within the tier's reporting window. The window closes on the delivery date of the reefer plus the tier's window length, counted in calendar dates, and a request made on that closing day is still in time; a request made after it is out of time. The delivery date is the one on the service record. A service can receive no more excursion credits than the tier's per-service number, the count being all excursion credits entered on that service over its life. A credit can be entered only on a service that is delivered or closed.

## Checklist

| Point | Read from | Met when |
|---|---|---|
| Timing of the request | delivery date on the service record | on or before the delivery date plus the window length |
| Credits already received | excursion credits entered on the service | fewer than the tier's per-service number |
| Stage of the service | service status | delivered or closed |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates and figures)

Suppose an imaginary tier with a window of 10 calendar days and one credit per service.

- A reefer delivered on 25 September 2026 has a window closing on 5 October 2026. A request on 5 October is in time; a request on 6 October is not.
- If the service already carries one excursion credit, a second is not available under that imaginary tier, whatever excursion it would compensate.
- A service still in transit cannot take a credit entry, since it is neither delivered nor closed.
- A service whose file has been closed after delivery can still take a credit, provided the request falls within the window.

## Points of judgement

- The window is counted from delivery, not from the date of the excursion itself.
- Calendar dates are counted, with the closing day included in the window.
